about.title: About Me
about.description: I am a Full-Stack Developer with experience in building scalable web applications using technologies such as JavaScript, Python, PHP, and C-based languages. I work across the full development lifecycle, from frontend interfaces with HTML, CSS, and modern frameworks, to backend services with Node.js, Express, and RESTful APIs. I have a strong foundation in database design and management, working with SQL and NoSQL solutions including MySQL, PostgreSQL, SQLite, MongoDB, and BigQuery, as well as data modeling and query optimization. I apply agile methodologies, UML modeling, and best practices like TDD and SDLC to deliver clean, maintainable, and user-centered solutions. I am continuously learning and motivated to grow through challenging and innovative projects.
